transcript.content: Hi, welcome in—I'm Dr. [Name]. To start, can you tell me what brings you in to see me today?
I came in because I’ve been eating too much sometimes, and then making myself throw up afterward so I won’t gain weight. It’s not just happened once—it’s becoming a pattern, and that scared me.
On average, how many times per week have these episodes of overeating followed by vomiting been happening, and for how many months has this been going on?
For the past several months, it’s been happening most weeks—usually at least once a week. I can’t really say it’s just occasional anymore.
During these episodes when you eat a lot, do you feel like you can't stop or control what or how much you're eating?
Yes. Once I start, it feels like I’m on automatic. I’m thinking I should stop before my husband notices, but I still keep reaching for one more thing.
Would you say your sense of self-worth is heavily tied to your body shape or weight—for example, do you judge yourself mainly based on how you look or what you weigh?
Yes, I think it is. If my skirt feels tight before church, or I catch my side view in a mirror at the store, it can ruin my whole day. I just feel like everybody can see that I’ve let myself go.
Can you tell me your current height and weight, or if you know your BMI?
I’m not sure of my BMI. I haven’t checked my weight recently, and I don’t know my exact height off the top of my head.

When you have one of these eating episodes, would you say you're eating an amount of food that's clearly larger than what most people would eat in that same time and situation, or does it feel like a smaller amount that just feels like 'too much' to you?

Yes, it’s definitely more than most people would eat. After a bridge night or a late shift, I can come home and have leftover casserole, cookies I baked, crackers, and ice cream—all in one sitting. It’s much more than I’d ever put on a plate if anyone else were around.
Can you tell me exactly how many months this pattern of binge eating and vomiting has been going on?
About seven months now. It started around when my husband stopped working outside the home, and my usual routines didn’t feel private anymore.
